pages.title: Disk Saver — Pinokio Manual
pages.headline: Disk Saver
pages.description: Pinokio Disk Saver finds byte-identical files across apps and lets them share physical storage, reclaiming disk space without changing their paths.
pages.ogImageAlt: Pinokio Disk Saver works across AI apps, package ecosystems, and operating systems

pages.title: Remote — Pinokio Manual
pages.headline: Remote
pages.description: Use apps installed on your own computers from your phone, tablet, or laptop through the Remote tab at pinokio.co, with private connections powered by Tailscale.
pages.ogImageAlt: Pinokio Remote at pinokio.co, open on a phone, tablet, and laptop

pages.title: Agent Messenger — Pinokio Manual
pages.headline: Agent Messenger
pages.description: Chat with the apps on your computer. Ask an app a question, have it do a job, fix it, or change it, with any AI agent, each chat in its own window inside Pinokio.
pages.ogImageAlt: Three agent chat windows side by side on a music app in Pinokio: Grok, Codex, and Claude Code
